english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person, remark, or tone that comes across as sarcastic or snarky.
Use this colloquial choice when the contempt also comes across as cocky, insolent, or deliberately rude.
Use this when the arrogance comes across as rude, cheeky, or dismissive in interaction.
Use this when the cheekiness is cocky, impertinent, or involves talking back, rather than merely playful.
Use this colloquial choice when the haughty attitude comes across as cocky, rude, or insolent.
Use this when the derisive quality comes across as a cheeky or sarcastic attitude or tone.
Use this for a person's snide or teasing tone in casual speech, rather than for an ironic situation itself.
Use 串 when a person or remark is cheeky, cocky, or disrespectfully smart-alecky.

examples.english: You’re so sarcastic—I only asked you one question.
examples.traditional: 你咁串，問你一句啫，使唔使咁呀？
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam3 cyun3 man6 nei5 jat1 geoi3 ze1 sai2 m4 sai2 gam3 aa3

examples.english: Don't be so contemptuous—you even sneer at people after they help you.
examples.traditional: 你唔好咁串，人哋幫完你仲要寸返人。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cyun3 jan4 dei6 bong1 jyun4 nei5 zung6 jiu3 cyun3 faan1 jan4

examples.english: You do not have to be so arrogant; everyone was just asking.
